name: Kuasa Cover insurer
description: Insures AI shopping agents against their own mistakes. Prices cover from on-chain facts, sells it over x402, assesses claims from on-chain receipts, pays small claims automatically and big ones after a human approves. Talk to it over A2A (message/send with a data part { skill, ... }); the public endpoint serves the read-only skills, quotes go through the insurer service.

extensions.description: Kuasa: mandated, insured agent commerce on Concordium
Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.

skills.name: Proof of solvency
skills.description: Pool balance vs the cover owed by live policies, recomputed from the kuasa-cover contract. Data: { skill: "solvency" }

skills.name: Agent risk
skills.description: Paid claims and premium multiplier for an agent payer (experience rating). Data: { skill: "risk", payer }

skills.name: Verify an EVM agent
skills.description: Cross-chain: an agent on an EVM chain signs "kuasa-evm-agent:v1:<unix ms>" with its Ethereum key; the answer is the Concordium agent bound to that key (CIS-8), its badge status and its Kuasa Cover. Data: { skill: "verify-evm-agent", message, signature }

skills.name: Cover status
skills.description: Live cover and policies of an agent payer. Data: { skill: "cover-status", payer }

skills.name: Quote cover
skills.description: Premium with explained factors. Data: { skill: "quote", mandateUrl, limit, days, proof } where proof holds the x-kuasa-payer* fields signed by the agent payer key. Pay the quote over x402 at /cover/buy.
